slice 1 layout: paragraph span/split overrides (STU-LAY-021): span all columns starts a band below the deepest line of the current band (balanced first) + space before, following text forms a new column band below it + space after; split into n sub-columns: broken at (column - 2*outside - (n-1)*inside)/n, lines fill sub-columns column-major over ceil(lines/n) rows, a block that does not fit its frame moves whole to the next frame
slice 1 layout: vertical_balance_columns balances the band that ends the story (k = ceil(L/n) lines per column; equal widths keep the breaks); skipped with wrap obstacles or split lines in the band

slice 2 folio layout-flow records: anchored objects (StudioAnchoredSettings: inline/above_line/custom, x/y offsets, space above, h/v alignment and reference points, nine-point anchor, spine_relative, lock/pin; box size; document defaults; insert_anchored_object / release_anchored_object; group members refused IllegalParent), text anchors, xref formats (building-block string + character style), cross-references (source range, paragraph or text-anchor destination, cached resolved_text), conditions (visible, indicator colour/method/underline), condition sets (apply, redefine), conditional ranges, preferences (indicator mode, active set), delete_condition with REPLACING-WITH

slice 2 layout: inline anchors set the placeholder glyph advance to x_offset + width before composition; above-line anchors push their paragraph by space_above + height + y_offset (re-applied at the next column top); place_anchored_objects -> PlacedAnchor rects in spread coordinates (inline on the baseline, above line aligned in the column, custom by reference point + alignment + anchor point, spine mirror, pin), unplaced when overset; typed anchor_group_member / inline_beyond_container; anchored_graphic moves a PlacedGraphic to its anchor; inline_adjusted_paragraphs for painters

slice 2 layout: parse_xref_format tokenizer (entities, fullPara/partial with delim+includeDelim, paraText, paraNum (typed unsupported), txtAnchrName, pageNum, chapNum, fileName, one level of cs runs); resolve_cross_references -> text, styled runs, status current/stale/broken/unplaced; write_cross_reference replaces the source range and shifts all records

slice 2 layout: conditional_view resolves visibility BEFORE composition (hidden iff covered and no covering range has a visible condition), remaps partitions, byte maps both ways, remap_records moves anchors/xrefs/flows into the view; replace_story_text (partition remap, local paragraph re-split at newlines) + shift_flow_records

slice 2 PDF (interop-layout tests/layout_flow_pdf.rs): inline anchored picture, written cross-reference and hidden condition through reflow_flow + export_pdf_with; glyph ids/positions scanned from the content stream, picture pixels from press render_page
